title: EnergySystems LoadForecastCSV

stats.done_summary: Completed annual load forecast and reliability assessment for power system operations. Analysis of 15-minute load data (Jan 1-7, 2026) revealed: System peak of 133.57 MW, average load of 119.43 MW, high load factor of 89.4%, projected annual energy of 1,046.21 GWh. Reliability assessment shows zero loss-of-load probability under standard reserve margin scenarios (10-20%). Generated 8 publication-quality figures including time series, daily profiles, load duration curve, and decomposition analysis. Deliverables include analysis code, intermediate outputs, and comprehensive report with reliability-oriented commentary.
